The outing

🐾 NC Museum of Natural Sciences

11 West Jones Street, Raleigh, NC, 27601 · Raleigh

Arrive 10:35 am, leave by 12 pm · Museum admission is free · No sign-up needed

  • 10:45 am–11 am 🐾 Live Animal Feeding – Ocean Habitat
  • Then 🌳 Fred Fletcher Park · map · if it’s dry

Add to calendar

Live Animal Feeding – Ocean Habitat at NC Museum of Natural Sciences

Google CalendarOpens Google Calendar with the event filled in, ready to save. Apple, Outlook or another calendarDownloads a calendar file. Open it on an iPhone, Mac or Outlook and tap Add.

Your child watches the ocean animals get their live feeding at the Museum of Natural Sciences at 10:45 am. Then they run off energy at Fred Fletcher Park, which has a playground and a garden.

  • Get there a few minutes early so your child can stand close for the feeding.
  • Pack a snack for the park, so the move from the museum feels like a treat.
  • Give a five-minute warning before leaving the playground, and let your child pick the last thing to do.

Closed, moved or not as we said? Tell us and we’ll fix it.

Or swap in

  • 📖 Family Storytime, then Leesville Community Park

    Leesville Community Library · North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 9:55 am–11:30 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Family Storytime at Leesville Community Library runs 10 am to 10:30 am, with books, rhymes and songs. Then your child can play at Leesville Community Park, which has a playground and a garden.

    • Sit near the front so your child can join the songs.
    • Bring a snack to eat at the park after the stories.

  • 📖 Preschool Storytime, then Edgemont Park

    Main Library · Durham · 10:20 am–12:10 pm

    Map · Free · Sign-up needed

    Preschool Storytime at the Main Library runs 10:30 am to 11:00 am for ages 3 to 5, with books, songs, movement and a simple craft. A family needs to sign up. Then your child plays at Edgemont Park.

    • Sign up ahead of time so your child has a spot.
    • Bring a snack and enjoy it at the park after the craft.

  • 🌳 Hemlock Bluffs Nature Preserve

    Cary / Apex · 2:30 pm–4 pm

    Map · Free

    Your child walks the mulched trails and boardwalks at Hemlock Bluffs and looks for leaves, seeds and critters along the way.

    • Bring a small bag so they can collect leaves and sticks to look at.
    • The trails have stairs, so wear shoes that grip and pack a snack for a rest on the way.
